remarks:
Stunning Country French–style estate filled with exceptional detailing and timeless design. Custom-built with quality craftsmanship, this prime property sits on 11 picturesque acres and includes a beautiful barn, paddock, and saltwater pool — truly a remarkable offering.

The first floor features a formal living and dining room, a wonderful kitchen with abundant counter and cabinet space, a walk-in pantry, and a breakfast bar. The fabulous family room provides the perfect place to entertain or unwind, while the cozy den overlooks a charming courtyard. A sensational first-floor owner’s suite offers a beautiful bath and serene retreat.

The second floor boasts three large bedrooms, three full baths, a convenient laundry room, and an expansive unfinished area (1,150 sq ft) ideal for a second owner’s suite or additional space for work, study, or play. Gorgeous French doors and windows, dual staircases, a terrific mudroom, and amazing curb appeal enhance the home’s character and functionality.

The barn features beautifully finished stalls and a second floor (2,016 sq ft) for endless possibilities for an office, recreation space, or buyer’s preference. 

This extraordinary premier property blends elegance, comfort, and versatility — a rare opportunity for country living at its finest.  Gutters, downspouts, soffits aluminum cladding recently replaced, heated roof NE, 2 - A/C units new 12/2023, professionally landscaped along with lighting and well with hand pump.  I'd like to Welcome you to your home!
